notes: Qty 59 as published: the 'Characters (8)' header lists 7 cards (Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith x2, Darth Vader With Lightsaber x3, Mara Jade, IG-88 With Riot Gun); the other headers match. The strategy says 'I start with 2' locations without naming them, and that Imperial Arrest Order starts against decks that don't start a site; no starting Effect is set.
'Traffic Control' is a Light Premiere Effect with no Dark card of that name; left as posted (UNKNOWN), not in GEMP.

Posted 'Darth Vader, DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w/Lightsaber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade, TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Death Star Docking Bay' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Twi-lek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Security Precatuions' Security Precautions.
DeckTech 6166 is a repost of this list by the same author with the same title (one extra line in the strategy); this page cites 6165.
